id.description: Unique authorize cross-walk vector identifier (e.g. acx-001)

kind.description: Each vector asserts the CLC decision for one grant projected by a pinned cross-walk profile, against one operation.

profile.description: Pinned cross-walk profile that maps the carrier's native representation to the grant in this vector.

grant.description: The CLC grant as projected by the profile. The mapping itself is the profile's responsibility and is described in derivation; the vector pins the projected form so the decision is reproducible without re-running the carrier.

execution_checks.description: Runtime execution-boundary and trigger-lock checks the profile leaves to the carrier. These are not carrier policy dimensions, are not mapped into a CLC field, and must not be reported as part of the decision. Kept in a member of their own so that policy delegation is never conflated with physical execution containment.

reason.description: Expected reason on deny (or on allow_unresolved when the spec assigns one).

unresolved.description: Expected residual obligations on allow_unresolved (§8.4), in the order the implementation reports them.

derivation.description: Who contributed the case, the native representation it came from, and how the profile produced the projected grant.
